name: chat-script
summary: Looks like a phone chat: soft grey-green background, white message cards and a green accent. Built for ready-to-copy messages agents can send to leads and clients, which makes the carousel worth saving.

archetypes.name: hook
archetypes.description: Centred heading promising copy-paste messages, small green kicker

archetypes.name: situation
archetypes.description: Short heading naming the moment, body text describes when to send it

archetypes.name: script
archetypes.description: The message to send, as a large quote in a white card with a label like 'Send this'

archetypes.name: cta
archetypes.description: Ask to save the carousel, green button

decorations: white message card panel with rounded corners
slide counter top right pill badge
hook_patterns: 'What to text a buyer who went quiet'
tone: Friendly, practical, helpful coach. Gives exact words to use.
caption_style: Opens with a one-line restatement of the hook, 3-6 short lines of value, a direct question to drive comments, then the CTA. 1-2 emojis max. 5-8 niche hashtags at the end.
